'''Radigan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who led a [[Radigan's swoop gang|swoop gang]] that was active in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Radigan became addicted to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], and the affects of the drug caused his veins to become discolored and visible from beneath his flesh, giving them the appearance of [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
